scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional in assessed scope. Subjective holistic scores, not a win/loss grade or arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: A complete, understandable short mission with strong assistance and coherent atmosphere; portrait combat visibility and timing friction prevent a higher grade.
reasons.controls: Large reachable buttons, tap aim, TURN and two-contact route/fire worked. Weapon/control footprint crowds scene; manual stick, scene swipes and fine AIM drag were not assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil windows and deck defense gave clear stages. DASH cancellation had explicit feedback. Much navigation could be held through, while threats behind camera and armored waits created friction. Longer-term challenge and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Consistent cyan/amber industrial rain atmosphere, named receivers and polished terminal panel. This is a visual assessment only; audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Readable handbook, persistent objectives, changing HOLD labels, map route and explicit upload progress supported completion without external instructions.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and coil progress were legible. Small distant enemies, small secondary text, dark geometry and a large foreground weapon made fine target reading less comfortable.
